name: Stonehenge
description: A prehistoric stone circle on Salisbury Plain in Wiltshire, England, built in stages between roughly 3100 and 1600 BC. A UNESCO World Heritage Site (1986) of central importance to British archaeology, it is also a focus of folklore and modern pagan and druidic ceremony.

aliases.name: Stanenges / Stanhenges
aliases.meaning: Possibly 'hanging stones'; recorded by 11th-12th century writers

origin: A single monument on Salisbury Plain, Wiltshire, England.
